scope: one bounded independent review of the D141i Agent-core-full measurement command before body admission

findings.detail: die() executes exit "\${2:-78}". The escaped parameter expression is passed literally, so refusal paths do not use the intended numeric default 78; all die call sites omit an explicit second argument.
findings.required_effect: Every refusal must terminate with the intended bounded numeric status and retain durable terminal handling.

findings.detail: The manifest declares JUnit at .../private/measurement-runs/agent-core-full.xml, while RUN_ROOT is .../private/measurement-runs/agent-core-full and the actual argv expands --junitxml to .../private/measurement-runs/agent-core-full/agent-core-full.xml.
findings.required_effect: manifest-declared JUnit destination must equal the actual argv destination, with no ambiguous receipt join.

findings.detail: record_disk after_body is explicitly ignored with || :. If the terminal disk witness cannot be read or written, the command can continue with body_rc=0 and monitor_rc=0; record_disk does not update evidence_rc, so this terminal custody failure can be hidden from PASS classification.
findings.required_effect: Before/during/after disk custody failures must make the run non-PASS and remain represented in terminal evidence.

findings.detail: positive.manifest and source-manifest.json declare profile_lock_sha ...be18e, but the existing /home/user/work/runtimes/agent-remotion-v3-819acf-1110/package-lock.json hashes to ...be18d. The recorded positive dry preflight is not sufficient to establish the current manifest/profile binding.
findings.required_effect: The positive manifest must bind the actual existing profile lock receipt before launcher admission.
